reviews.text: This is my personal experience with this breeder and with the Cavalier I was given. I got him when he was 6 months old, having already been rehomed from another family. He was the last of the litter. From the very beginning, he showed emotional problems, including intense emotional dysregulation. Francesco, the breeder, told me he has giardia and that he must take Panacur for the first 7 days of every month. This is absurd, according to all the vets I've spoken to. Furthermore, the dog has always suffered from chronic colitis and must only eat hypoallergenic foods. He is extremely itchy all over his body. I was stupid not to ask for tests for breed-specific conditions. The dog was given to me with a failing mitral valve and Addison's disease. €3,000.00 for a sick dog without any health tests. I love him and will take care of him until the end, but based on my experience, I can't recommend this breeder. Or at least demand all the necessary tests on the puppy and its parents. I've had two schnauzers in the past, and the breeder gave me everything without me even asking. This is my opinion, backed by tests and diagnostic tests. Negative personal experience.

We've known Francesco for twelve years now, and we entrust our Rottweiler to him with complete trust. Nothing but the best can be said about Francesco: he loves animals, is competent, caring, kind, and completely reliable. Even if the dog has health problems, he knows how to intervene promptly and effectively. Furthermore, Domus Aventina is in a beautiful location, with large green spaces for dogs, and heated and air-conditioned kennels (perfect for dog boarding during the summer months).
We couldn't recommend Domus Aventina highly enough to anyone who needs to leave their dog, knowing they'll be treated like they were at home!

Alessandra Ricci
Federica Manca

Four months ago I got a super-intelligent miniature short-haired dachshund named Achille. Now 7 months old, Achille is super cute and very, very clever. Francesco Di Pietro is super kind and helpful and awaits you with his four-legged friends. I highly recommend Domus Aventina!

Francesco is the best, both as a breeder and as a groomer. This is the second Cavalier King Charles Spaniel I've gotten from him, both beautiful specimens with no known health issues. My Luce is two years old now, and I made the grave mistake of taking her to a groomer
near home, who reduced her to a mess of knots and matted fur. Only Francesco was able to restore her to her former glory, giving her the care and attention he deserves, working with dedication and a true love for dogs.

Since I met Francesco, going on vacation is no longer a thought but a joy: I leave with a light heart, because I know my Takoda is having his dream vacation!
The place is a true paradise, cared for down to the smallest details, and the most beautiful thing is seeing him get excited even before he enters; he's excited and can't wait!
This isn't just a guesthouse: it's a second home, a family. There are not only wonderful spaces and impeccable services, but a sincere love that is felt in every gesture.
It's truly a 5-star guesthouse... actually, 10, because the affection they give is priceless! And they put up with me and console me in moments of homesickness when I need to know what's up. Thank you so much!

This place is a true paradise, managed with love and professionalism by owner Francesco Di Pietro: a dedicated, always available, and extremely competent person, attentive to the specific needs of each dog entrusted to him, whom he treats with affection and dedication as if he were his own child.

I now regularly bring my cocker spaniel Lucky here for grooming (performed expertly and with meticulous attention to his coat—which, thanks to Francesco's advice, we've "recovered" from previous poor groomings). In August, when Lucky was a guest at Domus Aventina, I was truly at peace knowing he was vacationing in a beautiful and special place, entrusted to the loving care of Francesco and his entire staff.

Thank you again for everything, and see you soon.

For about twenty years, first my mother and then I, we've been entrusting our pets to Francesco's care during the summer. I've always found our pets better than when I left them. Francesco loves animals deeply and is very knowledgeable and professional. He understands the real needs of dogs and cats and has a wealth of experience. I highly recommend him. A safe bet in a wonderful place where beauty reigns supreme.

I left my beloved Cavalier King Arthur at this beauty farm with complete peace of mind. I already knew Francesco by reputation, and I must say the experience truly exceeded my expectations. The professionalism is top-notch, and the facility is impeccable in every way: a corner of paradise with lush greenery, impeccable cleanliness, welcoming, air-conditioned rooms, and meticulous attention to every detail for the well-being of our furry friends.
But what really makes the difference is Francesco: a special person who deeply loves dogs and treats them with rare dedication. He spares nothing, caring for them as if they were people, with affection, patience, and attention to each individual. It's clear that his work is a true passion, and this is reflected in the serenity and happiness of the dogs.
I recommend Domus Aventina to anyone looking for a safe, clean, and loving place for their four-legged friend. An excellent service that truly deserves 5 stars.

Why trust Francesco and rely on him? Simply because he's a true professional who knows how to care for our dogs in every situation.
In mid-March, Ettore was diagnosed with a cervical hernia that required emergency surgery (they wanted to operate that same evening!!!), but Francesco disagreed because he believed that by following the medication and, above all, by keeping him well rested, Ettore would recover. So the next day, I brought him to the kennel, trusting him completely and the way he would care for him. I must say, I did the best thing I could...today I got Ettore back, he's walking briskly, he's no longer in any pain, and the vet confirmed that the hernia has reabsorbed.
Oh, I forgot... obviously Francesco had diagnosed the cervical hernia even before Ettore had the MRI... 😅
What can I say... just a heartfelt thank you, Francy, for your experience, your expertise, professionalism, and dedication, and for loving our dogs even more than we do.
Love, Annamaria and Ettore

A charming place, nestled in an unexpected oasis. Francesco and his staff make a difference in everything and everyone. I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to leave their furry friend in expert and loving hands. You won't regret it.

We are delighted with our decision to purchase our Vito from Domus Aventina Breeding. The owner is a true professional and his passion for animals is evident. Our puppy arrived home in perfect health, playful, and already housetrained. We really appreciated his willingness to answer all our questions, even after the adoption. If you are looking for a Cavalier, don't hesitate to contact Domus Aventina—you won't regret it!
